subject.title: refactor(agents): retire TOOLS.md into an AGENTS.md section with a doctor migration

question: Is it acceptable for existing workspaces to require `openclaw doctor --fix` before their former `TOOLS.md` notes reach agents through `AGENTS.md`?
rationale: The repository’s canonical-shape policy supports a doctor migration instead of a runtime fallback, but retiring a user-authored injected file makes skipped migration a visible behavior change for existing installations.

options.title: Approve doctor-only migration after refresh
options.body: Resolve the current conflicts and accept `openclaw doctor --fix` as the explicit upgrade path, with refreshed legacy-workspace proof on the resolved head.

options.title: Require a stronger upgrade surface
options.body: Keep the PR open until maintainers choose an additional visible recovery or migration trigger for users who have not run doctor.

recommendation.title: Approve doctor-only migration after refresh
recommendation.body: Resolve the current conflicts and accept `openclaw doctor --fix` as the explicit upgrade path, with refreshed legacy-workspace proof on the resolved head.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored both the current migration and the merged attestation prerequisite, so they are best positioned to clarify the intended upgrade contract.
